label: Untitled Goose Game sandboxes
description: How Untitled Goose Game sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: BepInEx itself is not a mod and this app does not install it. Unpack it into the game folder once; the sandbox's plugins go under the BepInEx/plugins folder it creates.
BepInEx writes each plugin's settings into BepInEx/config on first run; those belong to the game folder rather than the sandbox.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
